options.nativeBackupInfo: The app saves a backup file at every point, timeout, substitution, sanction, libero change, roster change, set start and end, match end and undo. Every file holds the whole match. Each match keeps its newest files (up to 64 MB and 500 files) plus latest.json; a match nobody scored for 12 hours keeps its newest 10 files, and files older than 30 days are removed (the newest file of a match is always kept).

home.q_createMatch: How do I create a new match?
home.a_createMatch: Tap the "New match" button and choose between Official match (full features, cloud sync) or Test match (simplified, for practice).
home.tip_createMatch: Tap this button to create a new match. Choose Official for real games or Test for practice.
home.q_officialVsTest: What is the difference between official and test matches?
home.a_officialVsTest: Official matches require complete rosters (6+ players per team), match officials, and signatures. Data syncs to the cloud. Test matches have simplified setup with no roster or signature requirements and store data locally only.
home.q_continueMatch: How do I continue a paused match?
home.a_continueMatch: Tap "Continue" on the active match card to resume scoring exactly where you left off.
home.tip_continueMatch: Tap here to resume your in-progress match.
home.q_deleteMatch: How do I delete a match?
home.a_deleteMatch: Tap "Delete" on the match card. Official matches require the game PIN for deletion to prevent accidental removal.
home.tip_deleteMatch: Tap here to delete the current match.
home.q_restoreMatch: How do I restore a match from backup?
home.a_restoreMatch: Tap "Restore match" and choose Cloud backup (enter game # and PIN) or Local backup (select a .json backup file from your device).
home.tip_restoreMatch: Tap here to restore a match from a cloud or local backup.
home.q_settings: How do I change the language or settings?
home.a_settings: Use the hamburger menu (☰) in the top-right corner to access language selection, display scale, fullscreen mode, and other options.

matchSetup.q_matchInfo: How do I fill in match information?
matchSetup.a_matchInfo: Tap the Match info card to enter game number, date, time, city, hall, and league. All fields are required for official matches.
matchSetup.tip_matchInfo: This card contains all basic match information. Tap each field to edit.
matchSetup.q_teamColors: How do I set team names and colors?
matchSetup.a_teamColors: Enter team names in the team cards. Tap the color swatch next to each team name to pick their jersey color. You can also set short names (max 8 characters) for display.
matchSetup.tip_teamColors: Tap the color swatch to change the team color, or edit the team name directly.
matchSetup.q_addPlayers: How do I add players to a team roster?
matchSetup.a_addPlayers: In the team roster section, enter the jersey number (1-99), last name, and first name. Optionally add date of birth. Tap "Add" or press Enter to add the player to the roster.
matchSetup.tip_addPlayers: Enter player details here and tap Add. Each team needs at least 6 players (not counting liberos).
matchSetup.q_importPdf: How do I import a roster from PDF?
matchSetup.a_importPdf: Tap "Import PDF" and select the official roster PDF file. The app will automatically parse player names and numbers from the document.
matchSetup.tip_importPdf: Tap here to import player data from an official roster PDF file.
matchSetup.a_liberos: In the roster list, check the L1 or L2 checkbox next to a player to designate them as libero 1 or libero 2. Each team can have up to 2 liberos.
matchSetup.tip_liberos: Check L1 or L2 to designate this player as a libero.
matchSetup.q_captain: How do I set the team captain?
matchSetup.a_captain: In the roster list, tap the captain star icon next to a player to designate them as team captain. Only one player per team can be captain.
matchSetup.tip_captain: Tap the star icon to designate this player as the team captain.
matchSetup.q_benchOfficials: How do I add bench officials?
matchSetup.a_benchOfficials: Scroll down in the team card to the Bench officials section. Add the coach, assistant coaches, physiotherapist, and medic with their names.
matchSetup.tip_benchOfficials: Enter bench official names here: coach, assistant coaches, physiotherapist, medic.
matchSetup.q_proceed: How do I proceed to the coin toss?
matchSetup.a_proceed: Complete all required sections (all cards show green checkmarks), then tap "Proceed to coin toss" at the bottom. All required fields must be filled for official matches.
matchSetup.tip_proceed: Tap here to proceed to the coin toss. All required fields must be completed first.

coinToss.q_record: How do I record the coin toss?
coinToss.a_record: After conducting the physical coin toss with team captains, select which team won the toss by tapping their name.
coinToss.tip_record: Select the team that won the coin toss here.
coinToss.q_serve: How do I select which team serves first?
coinToss.a_serve: After selecting the toss winner, choose whether the winning team wants to serve or receive first.
coinToss.tip_serve: Choose serve or receive for the toss-winning team.
coinToss.q_sides: How do I choose court sides?
coinToss.a_sides: Tap the court diagram to assign which team starts on which side (left or right).
coinToss.tip_sides: Assign teams to their starting court sides.
coinToss.q_start: How do I start the match?
coinToss.a_start: After all choices are confirmed (toss winner, serve/receive, court sides), tap "Start match" to proceed to the scoreboard.
coinToss.tip_start: Tap here to start the match and begin scoring.

scoreboard.q_startRally: How do I start the first rally?
scoreboard.a_startRally: First, set both teams' lineups by tapping each court position and assigning a player. Then tap "Start set" for the first rally, and "Start rally" for subsequent rallies.
scoreboard.tip_startRally: Tap here to start the rally. Both lineups must be set before the first rally.
scoreboard.q_awardPoint: How do I award a point?
scoreboard.a_awardPoint: After starting a rally, tap the point button for the team that scored. The button for each team is on their side of the scoreboard. Points can only be awarded during an active rally.
scoreboard.tip_awardPoint: Tap the team's point button after a rally to award them the point.
scoreboard.q_timeout: How do I call a timeout?
scoreboard.a_timeout: Tap the timeout counter (TO: 0/2) for the team requesting the timeout. Timeouts can only be called between rallies. Each team gets 2 timeouts per set, lasting 30 seconds each.
scoreboard.tip_timeout: Tap here to call a timeout for this team. Only available between rallies.
scoreboard.q_substitution: How do I make a substitution?
scoreboard.a_substitution: Tap a court player to select them, then choose "Substitute" and pick a bench player. Alternatively, drag and drop a court player to a bench player (or vice versa). On mobile, long-press to start dragging.
scoreboard.tip_substitution: Tap a player to select them for substitution, or drag and drop between court and bench.
scoreboard.q_libero: How do I enter or exit the libero?
scoreboard.a_libero: Drag the libero from the bench to a back-row position (I, V, or VI). A point must be awarded before the libero can enter. The libero can only replace back-row players.
scoreboard.tip_libero: Drag the libero from the bench to a back-row position (I, V, VI).
scoreboard.q_undo: How do I undo an action?
scoreboard.a_undo: Tap the "Undo" button to reverse the last action. You can undo multiple times to reverse several actions. The undo history is preserved until the set ends.
scoreboard.tip_undo: Tap Undo to reverse the last action. Repeat for multiple undos.
scoreboard.q_sanction: How do I record a sanction?
scoreboard.a_sanction: Tap on a player, then select the sanction type: warning (yellow), penalty (red, point to opponent), expulsion (red+yellow, player leaves for set), or disqualification (red+yellow, player leaves match).
scoreboard.tip_sanction: Tap a player to select them, then choose a sanction type from the menu.
scoreboard.q_lineup: How do I set the initial lineup?
scoreboard.a_lineup: Before the first rally, tap each court position (I through VI) and assign a player by selecting their jersey number. Both teams must have all 6 positions filled.
scoreboard.tip_lineup: Tap each position on the court to assign a player from the roster.
scoreboard.a_shortcuts: Enable keyboard shortcuts in Settings. Default keys: Left/right arrow for points, Q/P for timeouts, Z for undo, Space for start rally. You can customize all keys in Settings → Keyboard shortcuts.
scoreboard.q_setEnd: What happens at the end of a set?
scoreboard.a_setEnd: When a team reaches 25 points (15 in set 5) with a 2-point lead, the set ends automatically. The score display will show the final set result.
scoreboard.tip_setEnd: The score display shows current points and set results.
scoreboard.a_set5: Set 5 is played to 15 points (still need 2-point lead). Teams switch courts at 8 points. A new coin toss determines serve and sides.
scoreboard.tip_set5: The set indicator shows which set you're in and previous results.
scoreboard.q_changeDecision: How do I change a scoring decision?
scoreboard.a_changeDecision: Use "Undo" to reverse the last point. Then award the point to the correct team. For older decisions, use Manual adjustments from the menu.
scoreboard.tip_changeDecision: Tap Undo to reverse a scoring decision.

matchEnd.q_reviewResults: How do I review the match results?
matchEnd.a_reviewResults: The results table shows set-by-set scores, timeouts used, substitutions per set, set durations, and total match duration.
matchEnd.tip_reviewResults: This table shows the complete match results and statistics.
matchEnd.q_signatures: How do I collect final signatures?
matchEnd.a_signatures: Tap each signature field to open the signing pad. Collect in order: Team A captain, team B captain, scorer, 2nd referee (if present), 1st referee.
matchEnd.tip_signatures: Tap a signature field to open the signing pad and collect the signature.
matchEnd.q_exportPdf: How do I export the scoresheet as PDF?
matchEnd.a_exportPdf: Tap "Generate PDF" to create the official scoresheet in PDF format. The PDF includes all match data, scores, and signatures.
matchEnd.tip_exportPdf: Tap here to generate the official scoresheet PDF.
matchEnd.q_downloadJson: How do I download the match data?
matchEnd.a_downloadJson: Tap "Download JSON" to save the complete match data as a backup file. This file can be used to restore the match later.
matchEnd.tip_downloadJson: Tap here to download the complete match data as a JSON backup file.
matchEnd.q_reopenSet: How do I reopen a set to make corrections?
matchEnd.a_reopenSet: Tap "Reopen last set" to go back to scoring mode. Warning: this will clear all collected signatures, which will need to be collected again.
matchEnd.tip_reopenSet: Tap here to reopen the last set. Warning: all signatures will be cleared.

manualAdjustments.a_editScores: Select the "Scores" tab to view and modify set scores for any completed set. Adjust the scores for each team as needed.
manualAdjustments.tip_editScores: Select this tab to edit set scores.
manualAdjustments.q_editTeams: How do I edit team information?
manualAdjustments.a_editTeams: Select the "Teams & players" tab to modify team names, player details, add/remove players, and update bench officials.
manualAdjustments.tip_editTeams: Select this tab to edit teams, players, and officials.
manualAdjustments.q_editEvents: How do I edit past events?
manualAdjustments.a_editEvents: Select the "Timeouts & subs" tab to review and modify the event log, including timeouts, substitutions, and sanctions.
manualAdjustments.tip_editEvents: Select this tab to edit timeouts, substitutions, and sanctions.
manualAdjustments.q_saveChanges: How do I save my changes?
manualAdjustments.a_saveChanges: Tap "Save changes" at the bottom to apply all modifications. An audit log of changes is automatically created.
manualAdjustments.tip_saveChanges: Tap here to save all your changes.

import.title: Import from Excel or CSV
import.intro: Fill in the template (the sheet Entries, and Matches for your own plan) and choose the file, or one CSV file per sheet. You see a preview first; nothing changes before you apply it.

template.title: OpenBeach import
template.line1: One row per pair in the sheet Entries. Draw (the category, e.g. A1) and Gender name the draw; a draw the tournament does not have yet is created.
template.line2: A pair is found by both licence numbers, else by both names. A blank cell keeps the value. A pair missing from the file is withdrawn.
template.line3: Seeds: when a draw has seeds in the file, they replace the seeds of the draw.
template.line4: The sheet Matches is optional, for your own plan: each row finds its game by the game number and sets the date, time, court and officials. A draw without a bracket yet is drawn. Team 1 and Team 2 (a seed or a pair) are only checked.
template.line5: CSV: one file per sheet, with the same column names. Nothing changes before you apply the preview.

problems.xls: {{file}} is an old Excel file (.xls). Save it as .xlsx or CSV, then choose it again.

import.hasErrors: Some rows have errors. Correct the file, then choose it again.

import.changed: The tournament changed since the preview. This is the new preview: check it, then apply it again.
import.conflict: Another change of this tournament came first. Try again.

msg.bad_value: {{field}}: neither a text nor a number.
msg.bad_gender: Gender “{{value}}” is not men, women or mixed.
msg.bad_seed: Seed “{{value}}” is not a number from 1 to 128.
msg.bad_game: Game number “{{value}}” is not a number from 1 to 9999.
msg.bad_date: Date “{{value}}” is not a date like 11.07.2026.
msg.bad_time: Time “{{value}}” is not a time like 09:30.
msg.date_time_pair: Give both a date and a time, or neither.
msg.bad_court: Court “{{value}}” is not a number from 1 to 99.
msg.no_licence: A licence number is missing (MyBeach needs it for the ranking).
msg.duplicate_pair: The same pair as in row {{first_row}}.
msg.draw_drawn: The bracket of {{draw}} is drawn: only names, players and wildcards change. Reset the bracket first.
msg.draw_size: {{draw}} has {{teams}} pairs; a double elimination needs {{min}} to {{max}}.
msg.match_begun: Game {{game}} ({{match_code}}) has begun: its court and time stay.
msg.phase_mismatch: In the bracket, this game is in: {{expected}}.
msg.kept_drawn_one: {{draw}}: {{count}} pair is missing from the file and stays, because the bracket is drawn.
msg.kept_drawn_other: {{draw}}: {{count}} pairs are missing from the file and stay, because the bracket is drawn.
msg.seeds_assigned_one: {{draw}}: {{count}} pair gets its seed from the order (every pair needs one for the bracket).
msg.seeds_assigned_other: {{draw}}: {{count}} pairs get their seeds from the order (every pair needs one for the bracket).
msg.bad_char: {{field}} holds a control character. Is the file UTF-16? Save it as UTF-8 or as an Excel file.
msg.ambiguous_draw: The tournament has {{count}} draws {{draw}}: rename one first.
msg.date_outside: {{date}} is not a day of the tournament ({{starts_on}} to {{ends_on}}).
msg.reinstated: This pair is {{status}} and is entered again.

pin.title: Approval PIN
pin.explainer: Approve match results with your account instead of a drawn signature. Your personal PIN, not a match PIN. Never share it.
pin.disabled: Blocked after too many wrong PINs. Set a new one.

ineligible.role: Needs the referee or scorer role

pin.passwordHint: Your account password confirms the change.
pin.rule: 4 to 6 digits. No date, no year and no pattern such as 1212 or 1234.
pin.removeConfirmBody: You can no longer approve results with your account until you set a new PIN.

approval.pinHint: The official types their own approval PIN. It is set in their profile.
approval.stale: Result changed. Approve again or sign
approval.undoConfirmBody: The official then approves again or signs by hand.
approval.nameDiffers: Account name {{account}} differs from the official entered ({{entered}})
approval.revalidateFailed: An account approval is no longer valid. Check the signatures and approve again.

errors.pinInvalid: Email or PIN not accepted. After several wrong PINs the PIN pauses: the official sees it in their profile. Or sign by hand.
errors.pinFormat: The PIN must have 4 to 6 digits.
errors.pinWeak: This PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid dates, years and patterns such as 1212, 2580 or 1234.
errors.roleRequired: This account does not have the role for this signature.
errors.notMatchScorer: Only the scorer of this match can approve as scorer.
errors.nameRequired: The account has no name. Add it in the profile first.
errors.oneSlot: This account has already approved another signature of this match.
errors.slotTaken: Someone else has already approved this signature.
errors.matchNotEnded: The match has not ended on the server yet. Wait for the sync, then try again.
errors.resultNotSynced: The result has not reached the server yet. Check the connection and try again.
errors.unavailable: Approval with an account is not available on this server.
errors.emailUnconfirmed: The official has not confirmed the email address of the account yet.
errors.scorerNotReferee: The account that scores this match cannot approve as a referee.
errors.callerRole: Approving with an account needs a scorer or referee account on this device.

mine.title: Your approvals
mine.hint: Every approval made with your PIN. If one was not you, undo it while the match is open and change your PIN.
mine.undoBody: The approval no longer counts. The match is then approved again or signed by hand.

why.signOnly: Signature only: the assistant scorer does not approve with a PIN
why.locked: Match approved or closed: approvals can no longer change
why.beach: Approval with a PIN is not available for beach matches
why.localMatch: This match is not saved online: approval with a PIN needs an online match
why.noCloud: No online connection on this device: sign by hand
why.serverOff: Approval with a PIN is turned off on this server
why.signedOut: Sign in on this device to approve with a PIN
why.callerRole: The account on this device cannot send approvals: it needs the scorer or referee role
why.offline: Offline: approval with a PIN is offered again when back online

legal.signUpConsent: By creating an account you accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

describe.set5CoinToss: Coin toss for the deciding set

remark.exceptionalSub: Team {{team}}, Set {{set}}, Result {{score}}: player no. {{out}} is exceptionally substituted by player no. {{in}} due to {{reason}}.
remark.liberoUnable: Team {{team}}, Set {{set}}, Result {{score}}: Libero no. {{n}} is declared unable to play.
remark.liberoRedesignated: Team {{team}}, Set {{set}}, Result {{score}}: player no. {{n}} is designated as new Libero.
remark.delayedStart: Set {{set}} start time {{time}} ({{minutes}}' delay) due to {{reason}}.
remark.protest: Team {{team}}, Set {{set}}, Result {{score}}: protest (dictated by the captain, with the 1st referee's permission):
remark.missingSignature: Team {{team}}: the signature of the {{who}} is missing.

error.noLineup: No line-up is recorded for this team in set {{set}} at that score.
error.timeoutLimit: Both time-outs of this team are already recorded in set {{set}}.
error.subLimit: Six substitutions of this team are already recorded in set {{set}}.
error.choosePlayers: Choose the player going out and the player coming in.
error.liberoNotSubstituted: #{{n}} is a libero: a libero is not substituted. To correct a libero replacement, use Undo.
error.laterConflict: #{{out}} or #{{in}} takes part in a later substitution or libero replacement in this set. Remove that one first.
error.noLaterOpponentPoint: {{team}} has no later point in set {{set}} to mark as the penalty point. If the point was never recorded, use "Correct final score".
error.pointNowOnlyLive: The point can only be added now at the current score of the set being played.
error.winnerWouldChange: This would change who won set {{set}}. Use "Reopen last set" or ask the referee.
error.invalidFinalScore: {{score}} is not a possible final score of set {{set}}.
error.notLastPoint: The last point of set {{set}} was not won by {{team}}.
error.ladder: By the rules this is a {{expected}} (the team's earlier sanctions).
error.sameSanctionTwice: This person already has this sanction.
error.teamAlreadyWarned: The team has already been warned: only one warning per team per match.
error.readOnlyApproved: The match is approved. Reopen it for corrections first.
error.useUndo: This entry is corrected with Undo, Reopen set or the line-up tool, not removed here.
error.subEvent: This row belongs to another entry; remove that entry instead.
error.liberoOnCourtRotate: A libero is on court for this team: rotate after the libero has left the court.
error.removePointNotLast: The penalty point can only be removed while it is the last point of the set being played.
error.endBeforeStart: Set {{set}} cannot end before it starts.

note.ladder: By the rules this would have been a {{expected}}; recorded as the referee decided.
note.sameSanctionTwice: This person already has this sanction.
note.teamAlreadyWarned: The team had already been warned (only one warning per team per match).
note.circledPoint: {{team}}'s point at {{score}} becomes the circled penalty point.
note.pointNow: The point for {{team}} is added after the sanction.
note.pointStays: The point stays as a normal rally point (no longer circled).
note.penaltyNotNext: The rally after {{score}} was won by {{team}}, not by the opponent: check that the sanction was given at this score.
note.irBox: Team {{letter}}'s letter is crossed (X) in the improper-request box; no score is written.
note.expulsionReplacement: Record the replacement with "+ Add substitution" (exceptional if no legal substitution was possible).
note.laterRotations: Later rotations of this set are not recalculated.

corrections.help: Each correction is saved when you confirm it and is listed in the correction log for the referee.
corrections.saveError: The correction could not be saved: {{message}}

field.pointAlreadyGiven: Was the point already given to {{team}}?
field.addDelayRemark: Add a remark about the delayed start

action.wrongTeam: Last point went to the wrong team

preview.title: What changes on the scoresheet
preview.paperTimeout: "T" at {{score}} in the time-out box of {{team}}, set {{set}}.
preview.liveTimeout: Starts the time-out with its countdown, as the TO button does.
preview.paperSub: {{in}} in for {{out}} at {{score}} in the line-up column of position {{position}}.

chip.teamsNotSet: Team A/B not set: home is shown as A

hint.protest: Dictated by the captain, with the 1st referee's permission.
hint.finalScore: Only the end of the set can be corrected: a point added after the last point, or the last point removed. Points missed in the middle of a set cannot be fixed (Swiss scorekeeper course).
hint.libero: To correct a libero replacement during the match, use Undo.
hint.lineup: Fix the line-up before the first rally of the set; rotate a team when it stands one position off.
hint.advanced: Every entry of the match log. Removing an entry removes everything that belongs to it. Use the cards above to add or change entries.

confirm.timeoutCount: {{team}}'s time-out count in set {{set}} goes from {{from}} to {{to}}.
confirm.subRestore: #{{out}} returns to court at position {{position}}; later line-ups are updated.
confirm.removePoint: The point it gave is still the last point of this set. Remove it as well (as Undo would)?
confirm.addPoint: Give a point to {{team}} now, with its rotation and serve, as the point button does.
confirm.switchSides: Team {{left}} moves to the right, team {{right}} to the left.
confirm.discard: The changes in Teams and Match info are not saved yet.

banner.signaturesCleared: Signatures were cleared because the sheet changed. Collect them again at the match end.
banner.readOnly: The match is approved: corrections are read-only.

phoneSign.opened: Opened on a phone. Waiting for the signature…
phoneSign.expired: The link has expired. Make a new one.
phoneSign.cancelled: Signing on the phone was cancelled.

phoneSign.reasonSignIn: Sign in to sign on a phone over the internet. Or sign on this device.
